sections.title: Hotfix Gameplay Update
sections.description: This is a stadium gameplay update. Replay codes from the August 26, 2025 patch are still available.

blocks.title: Stadium Competitive Play
blocks.body:
- Round 1 Completion Cash increased to 10000 (Up from 7500).
- Round 2 Completion Cash increased to 7500 (Up from 5000).
- Round 3 and above Completion Cash increased to 5000 (Up from 4250).
- Bounty Increase per Elimination increased to 100 (Up from 75).
blocks.dev: Developer Comments: We're closely monitoring Best of 5 in Stadium Competitive and noticed players were earning less currency than intended. To address this, we're increasing passive currency gain to help players reach their full builds more consistently, while also strengthening comeback mechanics to make momentum shifts feel more impactful throughout the series.
